description: Regionalplanung Sachsen - Wasser und Hochwasser is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.sachsen.de. Regional planning definitions of the complex Spatial Use - Water and Floods are presented. This service contains data from the planning regions of the Chemnitz region and Upper Lusatia-Lower Silesia and covers the entire Free State of Saxony in the final expansion. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Regional Planning Saxony - Water and Floods" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include VRG Wasserversorgung, VR Standort technischer Hochwasserschutz, opendata, VBG Wasserversorgung, Hochwasserschutz, VB Standort technischer Hochwasserschutz. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
